title: Go to the Land
text: Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.

title: Every Family on Earth
text: … and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.

title: Abram Went
text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him …

title: To Your Offspring
text: I will give this land to your offspring.

title: He Called on the LORD
text: There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.

title: No Children
text: But Sarai was barren; she had no children.

title: All They Had
text: … all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran …

title: From Ur of the Chaldeans
text: … they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan.

title: Not Knowing Where
text: By faith Abraham … obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

title: All Nations Blessed
text: … and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”

title: The City God Builds
text: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
